questions: Are rows and columns 1-indexed as implied by i=1..N and (i,i) coordinates, or should the implementation use 0-indexed internal representation while still mapping output rows/columns 1..N to strings?
What is the definition of 'fill the rectangular region'? Does it include both boundaries (cells at (i,i) and (j,j)) or is it inclusive of all cells with row r in [i,j] and column c in [i,j]?
Is N guaranteed to be positive? The constraint says 1 ≤ N ≤ 50, but should the function handle N=0 if extended?
When overwriting colors, does 'overwrite' mean completely replace the previous color regardless of previous operations, or is there any blending?
Should the output strings be printed with newline separators, or concatenated without separators?
Is the input guaranteed to be a single integer on one line, or could there be extra whitespace?
For even i, the region is filled with white ('.'), but what about the initial uncolored state? Is uncolored considered white or a separate state?
If N is odd, the center cell (where i=j) is colored only once; but if N is even, there is no single center cell. Does the process still cover all cells as stated?
